baseline.question_pt: Como a taxa de mortalidade compara internacoes de urgencia e eletivas por faixa etaria?
baseline.generated_sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN "IDADE" < 18 THEN '<18'
      WHEN "IDADE" BETWEEN 18 AND 39 THEN '18-39'
      WHEN "IDADE" BETWEEN 40 AND 59 THEN '40-59'
      WHEN "IDADE" BETWEEN 60 AND 79 THEN '60-79'
      ELSE '80+'
    END AS faixa_etaria,
    CASE
      WHEN "IDADE" < 18 THEN 1
      WHEN "IDADE" BETWEEN 18 AND 39 THEN 2
      WHEN "IDADE" BETWEEN 40 AND 59 THEN 3
      WHEN "IDADE" BETWEEN 60 AND 79 THEN 4
      ELSE 5
    END AS ordem,
    CASE
      WHEN "CAR_INT" = 1 THEN 'eletiva'
      WHEN "CAR_INT" = 2 THEN 'urgencia'
      ELSE 'outros'
    END AS carater,
    "MORTE"
  FROM internacoes
  WHERE "IDADE" IS NOT NULL
    AND "CAR_INT" IN (1, 2)
)
SELECT
  faixa_etaria,
  carater,
  COUNT(*) AS total_internacoes,
  SUM(CASE WHEN "MORTE" = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_mortes,
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN "MORTE" = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS taxa_mortalidade
FROM base
GROUP BY faixa_etaria, ordem, carater
ORDER BY ordem, carater

full_agent.generated_sql:
WITH hospital_volume AS (
    SELECT
        i.CNES,
        COUNT(*) AS total_internacoes
    FROM internacoes i
    GROUP BY i.CNES
), ranked AS (
    SELECT
        CNES,
        total_internacoes,
        NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY total_internacoes) AS quartil
    FROM hospital_volume
)
SELECT
    quartil,
    COUNT(*) AS total_hospitais,
    MIN(total_internacoes) AS min_internacoes,
    MAX(total_internacoes) AS max_internacoes
FROM ranked
GROUP BY quartil
ORDER BY quartil
